import re
import os

user_msgs = []

                        texts.append(item.get("text") or "")

            elif isinstance(out, str):
                texts.append(out)
            outputs[cid] = "\n".join(texts)
        elif o.get("type") == "event_msg" and isinstance(p, dict):

cmd_re2 = re.compile(r"shell_command\(\{command:\s*'((?:\\.|[^'\\])*)'", re.S)

print("=== USER MESSAGES ===")
for ts, m in user_msgs:
    print(f"\n[{ts}]\n{m}\n")

print("\n=== GIT-RELATED EXEC + OUTPUT ===")
for ts, cid, inp in exec_calls:
    cmds = []
    for rx in (cmd_re, cmd_re2):
        cmds.extend(rx.findall(inp))
    if not cmds and ("git " in inp or "commit" in inp or "push" in inp):
        # fallback: show snippet
        cmds = ["<<raw>> " + inp[:500]]
    interesting = []
    for c in cmds:
        c2 = bytes(c, "utf-8").decode("unicode_escape") if "\\" in c else c
        if any(k in c2.lower() for k in ["git ", "push", "commit", "status", "diff --stat", "log -"]):
            interesting.append(c2)
    if not interesting and ("git " in inp.lower()):
        interesting = [inp[:700]]
    if not interesting:
        continue
    out = outputs.get(cid, "")
    print(f"\n--- {ts} call={cid} ---")
    for c in interesting:
        print("CMD:", c[:800].replace("\n", " | "))
    # show key parts of output
    out_short = out

        out_short = out_short[:1000] + "\n...\n" + out_short[-1000:]
    print("OUT:", out_short.replace("\r", ""))

print("\n=== FINAL AGENT MESSAGES (last 5) ===")

import json
import re

path = r"C:\Users\win\.codex\sessions\2026\07\30\rollout-2026-07-30T20-06-50-019fb2eb-8ec5-7cc3-9421-c99d5179701c.jsonl"

exec_calls = []
outputs = {}
agent_msgs = []

with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
    for line in f:
        o = json.loads(line)
        p = o.get("payload")
        if not isinstance(p, dict):
            continue
        ts = o.get("timestamp", "")
        pt = p.get("type")
        if pt == "custom_tool_call" and p.get("name") == "exec":
            exec_calls.append((ts, p.get("call_id"), p.get("input") or ""))
        elif pt == "custom_tool_call_output":
            cid = p.get("call_id")
            out = p.get("output")
            texts = []
            if isinstance(out, list):
                for item in out:
                    if isinstance(item, dict) and "text" in item:
                        texts.append(item.get("text") or "")
            elif isinstance(out, str):
                texts.append(out)
            outputs[cid] = "\n".join(texts)
        elif o.get("type") == "event_msg" and p.get("type") == "agent_message":
            agent_msgs.append((ts, p.get("message") or ""))

# Find command strings that include git commit / push / status after changes
keys = ["git commit", "git push", "git add", "git status", "git log", "git diff --stat", "git rev-parse"]

def unescape(s):
    try:
        return bytes(s, "utf-8").decode("unicode_escape")
    except Exception:
        return s

cmd_pat = re.compile(r'command:\s*"((?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"')

rows = []
for ts, cid, inp in exec_calls:
    if not any(k in inp for k in keys):
        continue
    cmds = [unescape(c) for c in cmd_pat.findall(inp)]
    git_cmds = [c for c in cmds if any(k in c for k in keys)]
    if not git_cmds:
        # whole input may be one command string
        if any(k in inp for k in keys):
            git_cmds = [inp]
    out = outputs.get(cid, "")
    rows.append((ts, git_cmds, out))

print(f"git-related execs: {len(rows)}\n")
for ts, cmds, out in rows:
    print("=" * 80)
    print(ts)
    for c in cmds:
        print("CMD:", c[:1200])
    # keep exit-relevant lines
    lines = out.splitlines()
    keep = []
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        l = line.lower()
        if any(x in l for x in [
            "exit code", "[main ", "file changed", "files changed",
            "create mode", "delete mode", "insertions", "deletions",
            "to github", "main -> main", "up to date", "ahead of",
            "nothing to commit", "changes to be committed", "modified:",
            "new file:", "deleted:", "fatal", "error:", "rejected",
            "enumerating", "writing objects", "branch '", "commit "
        ]) or re.search(r"\b[0-9a-f]{7}\b", line):
            keep.append(line)
    if not keep:
        # fallback tail
        keep = lines[-40:]
    print("OUT:")
    for line in keep[:80]:
        print(" ", line)
    print()

print("\n=== LAST AGENT MESSAGE ===")
if agent_msgs:
    print(agent_msgs[-1][0])
    print(agent_msgs[-1][1][:3000])

# Count push specifically
print("\n=== PUSH COMMAND COUNT ===")
push_n = 0
for ts, cmds, out in rows:
    joined = "\n".join(cmds)
    if "git push" in joined:
        push_n += 1
        print("PUSH at", ts)
        print("OUT snippet:", out[-800:])
print("total push execs:", push_n)

你的直觉有一半对：**改在本地是真的，但那条 Codex 线程本身没有推送**；GitHub 上现在能看到，是因为后来另一次 push。

## 结论

| 问题 | 结论 |
|------|------|
| 是否改在本地 `C:\Users\win\Desktop\alpha`？ | **是**。会话 cwd 就是这个目录，不是沙箱/别的盘。 |

import json
